sanitization.historical_failures: Preserved including no-reset watchdog guard failure and failed first Wi-Fi attempts.
sanitization.sources: Source copies are exact bytes, never sanitized in place; export fails on a sensitive match.

scope: USB/Wi-Fi investigation, sanitized allowlisted evidence; no device access during export.

source_proofs.scope: Exact copied source version only; older result hashes remain authoritative.

application_checks.scope: Application-function test cases only; do not add to independent Wi-Fi probe cycles or reset totals.

limits: Counts cover completed exported cases only, not in-flight cases.
USB precondition failure explicitly marked no-reset is not a hardware reset failure.
Wi-Fi PASS cycles require the recorded DHCP/status/body checks; no DNS claim.
Radio boot PASS is activation/cleanup, not peer traffic or Wi-Fi association.
Hardware USB root cause is not established by native unit tests.

soft_sleep.scope: lightsleep followed by machine.soft_reset; not a hardware reset or USB re-enumeration test.
